checks.ref:
command:stray=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$stray" ]; then
  echo "this stage changes no file of the repository, but the working copy carries:"
  echo "$stray"
  echo "write the pull request body under \$TMPDIR, not into the working copy; undo what you wrote here and nothing else."
  exit 1
fi

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) echo "not on a task branch: $branch"; exit 1 ;; esac
issue=${task##*-}
if ! prs=$(gh pr list --head "$branch" --base main --state open --json number,title,body 2>&1); then
  echo "cannot verify: gh pr list failed: $prs"
  exit 126
fi
count=$(printf '%s' "$prs" | jq length)
if [ "$count" != 1 ]; then
  echo "expected exactly one open pull request from $branch into main, found $count"
  exit 1
fi
title=$(printf '%s' "$prs" | jq -r '.[0].title')
body=$(printf '%s' "$prs" | jq -r '.[0].body')
problems=""
printf '%s' "$title" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|refactor|perf|test|docs|build|ci|chore)(\([a-z0-9-]+\))?!?: [^ ].*[^.]$' \
  || problems="$problems\n- the title '$title' is not a Conventional Commits subject (type(scope): outcome, no trailing period)"
[ ${#title} -le 72 ] || problems="$problems\n- the title is ${#title} characters, the limit is 72"
for heading in '## Why' '## What changed'; do
  printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -qx "$heading" || problems="$problems\n- the body has no '$heading' section"
done
printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -qE "(Closes|Fixes|Resolves) #$issue([^0-9]|$)" \
  || problems="$problems\n- the body does not close the task's issue: add 'Closes #$issue'"
if [ -n "$problems" ]; then
  printf 'pull request #%s:%b\n' "$(printf '%s' "$prs" | jq -r '.[0].number')" "$problems"
  echo "fix it with gh pr edit, never a second pull request"
  exit 1
fi
